title: engineering-all-hands-2026-06-10
content:
Engineering All-Hands notes — 2026-06-10
Owner: Priya Nair (platform-eng)
Attendees: ~110 engineers (signal from RSVP), edits from Ethan, Sofia, Liam, Maya

Agenda:
- Quick metrics + ops highlights
- Team updates (Serving runtime, Observability, Private deployments, Console)
- Feature launches and rollouts
- Hiring & org updates
- Action items / todos / Q&A recap

1) Metrics & Ops snapshot
- Uptime: 99.98% last 7 days (one short region-specific blip on 2026-06-07 in us-west, root cause: autoscaler misconfig with burst pools; INFRA-234)
- Production p95 token latency (text-gen): 72ms (global) — steady improvement from 86ms in May after kernel optimization rollout
- Total tokens/day: ~1.4B (hosted API + dedicated) — 7% week-over-week growth
- Error rate (5xx): 0.17% — higher than target of 0.1% due to a regression in model fallback logic (see ENG-4821)

Notes: ops team applied a hotfix (PR #1289) on 2026-06-09 that reduced fallback errors by ~60%. We still need a thorough unit test to prevent recurrence.

2) Team updates (high-level)
- Serving Runtime (lead: Ethan)
  - Kernel selection improvements shipped to prod for LlamaX-70b variants; observed 10-12% CPU/GPU perf gain on p50 latencies for long-context workloads.
  - Ongoing: KV cache compaction work to reduce memory pressure for high-concurrency endpoints. Target merge: 2026-06-17.
  - Blockers: one flaky integration test in quantized path; engineering debugging session Friday.

- Observability (lead: Sofia)
  - New per-route cost dashboards are live in Console beta for a subset of enterprise orgs — feedback welcome (link in Confluence).
  - Traces: added model-variant tagging so rollouts can be correlated with quality regressions (helps QA and Optimize).
  - Next: increase retention for token-level traces for Dedicated customers (proposal in product review).

- Private Deployments (lead: Liam)
  - Private VPC installer v1.2 released to early customers; addressing a KMS integration bug reported in customer-012 (support ticket: CUST-559).
  - On-prem package docs updated; there's a gap in upgrade instructions for air-gapped environments — doc owner assigned (Maya).

- Console & Rollouts (lead: Maya)
  - Canary rollout UX polished; canary metrics now show traffic split and model delta graphs side-by-side.
  - Work in progress: A/B rollout automation for canary->full with safety gates (expected Q3 alpha).

3) Feature launches / rollouts
- Dedicated autoscaling policy v2 (beta): rolling out to internal partner accounts this week. Expected improvements: 18% better utilization in dev clusters during steady-state.
- Model catalog tagging: new "latency-sensitive" tag applied to recommended variants in hosted API. Teams should check tag changes before pinning models.

4) Incidents & Postmortems
- 2026-06-07 region blip (us-west): root cause was misconfigured burst pool policy causing transient capacity thrashing. Postmortem draft: ENG-INC-2026-06-07 (link in Confluence). Action items: tighten autoscaler defaults, add synthetic load test for burst behavior.

5) Hiring & org updates
- Platform-eng: hiring for Staff/Sr Staff SRE (2 reqs), Senior Runtime Engineer (3 reqs). Please refer candidates to careers@redwood.ai; interview loops updated in hiring playbook.
- Eng All-Hands schedule: next all-hands 2026-06-24 (note: skipping 6/17 due to internal offsite).

6) Action items / todos (owners assigned)
- Ethan: finish KV cache compaction PR and resolve integration test flakes (due 2026-06-17).
- Sofia: finalize retention proposal for Dedicated traces and present to Product on 2026-06-15.
- Liam: address KMS integration bug for private deployments and update CUST-559 support thread (due 2026-06-14).
- Maya: publish air-gapped upgrade doc, link to installer repo, and add upgrade checklist (due 2026-06-16).
- Priya: schedule cross-team tabletop for autoscaler burst behavior and follow-up synthetic test requirements (meeting: 2026-06-12).

7) Questions & quick answers from Q&A
- Q: Any immediate customer impact from the fallback regression?
  - A: Most customers saw higher 5xx rates briefly; hotfix mitigated ~60% of cases. We're putting an alert and a runbook in place.
- Q: Is there a timeline for A/B automated rollouts?
  - A: Target alpha in Q3; will be gated by rollout safety gates and observability hooks.

8) Misc notes / FYI
- Reminder to link any rollout or infra PR to the corresponding Confluence rollout plan and Jira ticket.
- Retro reminder: please add one pain & one win for the last sprint in the retro doc (link in Confluence).

9) Closing
- Thanks to the runtime and infra teams for the quick hotfix last week. Small wins compound — keep surfacing perf wins and painful spots in #eng-ops.

Document history: created 2026-06-10, last edit and publish 2026-06-11 by Priya Nair.
